rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is really or genuinely so.

example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 sam1 wo3

rows.note: Use this before an adjective when English means very, as in being very angry or very tired.

example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 gui6 aa3

rows.note: Use 真正 as the all-purpose adjective for something genuinely or really what it is, rather than nominal or fake.

example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 hai6 zan1 zing3 ge3 zyun3 sek6

rows.note: Use 真實 when stressing that something actually exists or corresponds to reality, especially in descriptions such as real life.

example.english: The novel is based on real events.
example.traditional: 套小說以真實事件為藍本。
example.jyutping: tou3 siu2 syut3 ji5 zan1 sat6 si6 gin6 wai4 laam4 bun2

rows.note: Use 嚴重 when real means serious or grave, as in a real problem.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 jim4 zung6 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use 真誠 for feelings or behaviour that are sincere and unfeigned.

example.english: We could feel their real concern.
example.traditional: 我哋感受到佢真誠嘅關心。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam2 sau6 dou2 keoi5 zan1 sing4 ge3 gwaan1 sam1
